correctness.rationale: Normal-line offsets are angular support derivatives. On coaxial ellipses their difference reduces to four copies of the variation of H(u)=sqrt(b²+Au)-sqrt(d²+Cu). The sign of H’ equals that of affine S(u)=A²d²-C²b²+AC(A-C)u, so only endpoint-monotone and unique-interior-switch cases exist; the latter has the exactly eliminated radical z²=(A-C)(Cb²-Ad²)/(AC). The formula includes all boundary equalities and disk cases. Exact rational verification of E(3,2),E(2,1), and 252 direct-quadrature comparisons, supports—not substitutes for—the analytic proof.
